SELECT
    s."first_name" || ' ' || s."last_name" AS "full_name",
    i."source" AS "income_source",
    MAX(CAST(i."amount" AS NUMERIC)) AS "max_income"
FROM
    "students" s
JOIN
    "income" i ON s."id" = i."student_id"
GROUP BY
    s."id", s."first_name", s."last_name", i."source"
ORDER BY
    "max_income" DESC
LIMIT 1;
